description: This file defines a React component for a help/contact form using Formik for form management and Yup for validation. It includes form fields for name, email, subject, and message, and handles form submission via an API call.

methods.name: InnerForm
methods.description: React functional component rendering the form fields and validation messages.

methods.name: mapPropsToValues
methods.description: Maps component props to initial form values.

methods.name: validationSchema
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the form fields using Yup.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls API, and updates form status.
